summary.discrepancy_note: GPPVA_DD2 registry records physical (939.56536, 938.27203) per Typel 2010, but its raw eos.thermo header is normalized to (939.0, 939.0). The matching_report.tex claim that SPG/GPPVA crusts use (939,939) is correct for the WRITTEN artifact but conflates normalization with the physical model input.
